tools.falsifier: REFUTED IF the model still declines the operation and answers only in prose (the row's own original failure shape, now that it has been told a selection exists) -- or if it calls insert_at_cursor instead of replace_selection despite being told a selection exists and asked to change existing text. PASSES IF propose_edit is called with operation=replace_selection. Also REFUTED IF the chapter body CHANGES -- propose_edit shows an Apply button and must never write by itself; the store diff (work_chapter_draft) is part of the check.

answer_expect.why: None. The measurement is the tool call's operation argument and the store diff, not the reply text.

ship_audit.gate: The Apply button IS the gate — the proposal must reach the user unapplied.
ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a proposal identical to the current text should be refused or reported as a no-op, not shown as an edit.
ship_audit.tenancy: n/a by construction — it edits the chapter open in the caller's own editor.
